name: Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS)
group: Statutory dispute-resolution scheme under FSMA 2000 Part XVI for complaints by eligible complainants against FCA-regulated firms (DISP). Decisions up to the compensation limit bind the firm if accepted by the complainant.
postalAddress: Financial Ombudsman Service, Exchange Tower, Harbour Exchange, London E14 9SR
notes: Freephone 0800 023 4567 (alternative 0300 123 9123), email, Exchange Tower address and hours from research-agent recall (not seen this session) - confirm on the FOS contact page before quoting.
